receipt.reason: The independent review found that future-stage WI-1068 scenario text says the new tag triggers the release workflow, while .github/workflows/release.yml is workflow_dispatch-only and the published documentation states that a tag push alone does not start publication. Correct only the expected result and verification plans to require explicit dispatch after fresh Runtime publication admission and the annotated tag push. Preserve the 16 product paths, actual v1.0.0 N-1 route, four targets, and no-overwrite restriction.

changedValues.newValue: After Runtime publication admission and creation of the new immutable v1.0.1 tag, explicitly dispatch the existing workflow in candidate-publication mode; require four-target candidate install/smoke and staged N-1 checks to finish before public Release publication.

Require candidate install/smoke for all four declared targets and staged Linux x86_64 N-1 acceptance before public Release upload.
